extendedData.value:
Theme Boosters are perfect for players looking to expand their collection with a specific strategy in mind. These larger booster packs are full of cards all based on a single theme. Players who are looking to build their specific deck but still love the surprise of opening booster packs will love the Theme Booster. You are purchasing a set of all five colors: White, Black, Blue, Red and Green.

Contents of each pack:
• 35 cards from Theros Beyond Death, all themed around a single color
•1 rare or mythic rare
